title: Persistent AI Worlds: papers, simulations and data
description: Source repository for two papers by Lachlan Bremner: Running Persistent AI Worlds (second edition, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23558245), a review of multi-agent simulations with progressive learning, and River World on the Desktop (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23338390), six pre-registered experiments in a persistent multi-agent world with a river. It holds both papers, their build sources, the reference simulations, the river-world kit, and the per-year logs and findings of every run; the run checkpoints are in doi:10.5281/zenodo.23338577.
